title: What If Everyone Worked Four Days a Week?

scenes.text: What if you worked only four days for full pay? The strangest result was the revenue.
In 2022, 61 UK firms cut hours 20 percent for six months, with no pay cut, for about 2,900 workers.
Sick days fell about 65 percent, and staff departures dropped 57 percent versus the year before.
About 71 percent of employees reported less burnout, and 39 percent said they felt less stressed.
Revenue stayed roughly flat. Among the 23 firms that supplied data, it rose about 1.4 percent on average.
By the end, 56 of the 61 firms planned to keep it, and 18 made it permanent.

description:
What if everyone worked four days a week?
In a UK pilot of 61 firms, revenue held steady, burnout fell, and 92 percent of companies kept the shorter week.
